import copy,json
from work import evaluate

def check(request,evidence,policy,expected):

    actual=evaluate(request,evidence,policy)
    assert actual==expected,(actual,expected)

check({'claim':'c','conditions':{}},[],{'required_conditions':['z','a']},{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['a','z']})
